cards.ex: We finished the project down to the wire, but we got it done.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihani oxirgi daqiqada tugatdik, lekin uni uddaladik.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi lahzada, muddatning tugashiga juda yaqin qolganda bajarish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project before it's too late.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu loyihani kech bo'lmasidan boshlab olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Bir ishni boshlash, jarayonni faollashtirish.

cards.ex: We're working under a tight deadline to finish the report.
cards.exUz: Biz hisobotni tugatish uchun qattiq muddat ostida ishlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt juda kam bo'lgan, bajarish uchun qiyin bo'lgan muddat.

cards.ex: I've been burning the midnight oil trying to finish this presentation.
cards.exUz: Men bu taqdimotni tugatish uchun kechgacha ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tungacha qattiq ishlash.

cards.ex: The project is moving at a snail's pace; we need to speed things up.
cards.exUz: Loyiha juda sekin sur'atda ketyapti; biz ishlarni tezlashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin, juda sust harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The project is on track to be completed by the end of the month.
cards.exUz: Loyiha oyning oxirigacha tugatilish rejasida.
cards.uzDef: Reja bo'yicha ketayotgan, maqsadga erishish yo'lida.

cards.ex: We had to push back the meeting due to unforeseen circumstances.
cards.exUz: Biz kutilmagan vaziyatlar tufayli uchrashuvni keyinga surishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Muddatni yoki hodisani keyinroq vaqtga ko'chirish.

cards.ex: Now that I'm feeling better, I need to make up for lost time at work.
cards.exUz: Endi o'zimni yaxshi his qilganimdan so'ng, ishda yo'qotilgan vaqtni qoplashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotilgan vaqtni qayta tiklashga harakat qilish, tezroq ishlash.

cards.ex: Filling out these forms is very time-consuming.
cards.exUz: Bu blankalarni to'ldirish juda ko'p vaqt oladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vaqt talab qiladigan, bajarish uchun uzoq vaqt ketadigan.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of hand.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni jilovlashdan oldin, ildizida yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlanishidan oldin to'xtatish, rivojlanishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: You have a 30-day grace period to pay the bill.
cards.exUz: Sizda to'lovni amalga oshirish uchun 30 kunlik imtiyozli muddat bor.
cards.uzDef: Muddat tugaganidan keyin ham qo'shimcha vaqt berilishi.

cards.ex: We finished the project by the skin of our teeth.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihani zo'rg'a tugatdik.
cards.term: by the skin of your teeth
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofada, qiyinchilik bilan muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: That was a close call; we almost missed the deadline.
cards.exUz: Bu xavfli vaziyat edi; biz deyarli muddatni o'tkazib yubordik.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noqulay vaziyatdan ozgina farq bilan qutulish.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz yana boshidan boshlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Yana boshidan boshlashga majbur bo'lish, avvalgi holatga qaytish.

cards.ex: Please respond to my email in a timely manner.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, elektron pochtamga o'z vaqtida javob bering.
cards.uzDef: O'z vaqtida, belgilangan vaqt ichida.

cards.ex: This information is time-sensitive, so please share it immediately.
cards.exUz: Bu ma'lumot vaqtga bog'liq, shuning uchun uni darhol ulashing.
cards.uzDef: Tezkorlik bilan bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan, vaqt o'tishi bilan ahamiyatini yo'qotadigan.

cards.ex: We need to review the project's progress on a regular basis.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihaning rivojlanishini doimiy ravishda ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muntazam ravishda, tez-tez sodir bo'ladigan.

cards.ex: Time will tell if this new strategy works.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi strategiya ishlashini vaqt ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Natija qanday bo'lishini faqat vaqt ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: She hit the ground running and quickly became a valuable member of the team.
cards.exUz: U tezda ishga kirishdi va tez orada jamoaning qimmatli a'zosiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni juda tez va samarali boshlash.

cards.ex: Don't drag your feet on this project; we need to finish it soon.
cards.exUz: Bu loyihani sekinlashtirmang; uni tez orada tugatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni bajarishni kechiktirish, xohlamaslik.

cards.ex: I had to bite the bullet and work overtime to finish the report.
cards.exUz: Men hisobotni tugatish uchun tishni tishga qo'yib, qo'shimcha ishlashga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz narsani bajarishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: I've been under the gun all week trying to meet the deadline.
cards.exUz: Men butun hafta davomida muddatni bajarish uchun bosim ostida ishladim.
cards.uzDef: Katta bosim ostida bo'lish, stressda ishlash.

cards.ex: This is a small window of opportunity to invest in the company.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritish uchun kichik imkoniyat oynasi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida mavjud bo'lgan imkoniyat.

cards.ex: The company's success was short-lived.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning muvaffaqiyati qisqa umr ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt davom etadigan, tez tugaydigan.

cards.ex: We need to focus on the big picture and not get bogged down in the details.
cards.exUz: Biz umumiy manzaraga e'tibor qaratishimiz va tafsilotlarga berilib ketmasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy vaziyat, asosiy maqsad.

cards.ex: The project is on hold until we get more funding.
cards.exUz: Loyiha qo'shimcha mablag' olgunimizcha to'xtatib turiladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik to'xtatilgan, keyinroq davom ettirilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The holidays are just around the bend.
cards.exUz: Bayramlar yaqin kelajakda.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada sodir bo'ladigan, yaqin kelajakda.

cards.ex: As the project manager, she gets to call the shots.
cards.exUz: Loyiha menejeri sifatida u qaror qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish, vaziyatni nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: He was just playing for time, hoping someone else would solve the problem.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki vaqt yutayotgan edi, kimdir muammoni hal qilishiga umid qilib.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtni cho'zish, kechiktirish, maqsadingizga erishish uchun.

cards.ex: This is a time-tested method for solving the problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilishning vaqt sinovidan o'tgan usuli.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida yaxshi ekanligi isbotlangan.
